methods.name: ctree Monte Carlo permutation p-values (testtype MonteCarlo)
methods.reference: partykit::ctree 1.3.1, ctree_control(testtype = 'MonteCarlo', nresample = 9999, stump = TRUE), set.seed(1)
quantities: Monte Carlo p-values (within Monte Carlo error)
methods.tolerance: root statistics: validation/README.md, n = 120. Monte Carlo p-values: p2a's and R's are two independent permutation draws, so each lies within 4 sqrt(2 p (1 - p) / B) + 2 / B of R's value, p R's value and B = 9999; this is the sampling error of two independent estimates, not a widened tolerance
